result.description: Northpeak Orion Crest LX is a fictional desktop-grade external archive drive designed for long-term media backup and bulk project storage. It uses a USB4/Thunderbolt bridge for high-speed transfers, includes a built-in hardware write-protect toggle, and ships in a ventilated aluminum enclosure for quiet operation. The drive is positioned for photographers, editors, and lab users who need a portable cold-storage style device rather than a graphics or internal SSD component.
result.title: Orion Crest LX 2TB Thunderbolt External Archive Drive
result.title_description: 2TB external archive hard drive with USB4/Thunderbolt connectivity
